name: application-checkboxes
title: Checkboxes
description: Checkbox input components with styled checkboxes, labels, descriptions, and responsive designs for forms, settings, and user interfaces.
useWhen: Checkbox input components with styled checkboxes, labels, descriptions, and responsive designs for forms, settings, and user interfaces.
avoidWhen: Avoid checkboxes when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Checkboxes uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
